name: model.routing
description: Gate a claim that an agent surface's model routing is clean and working: every role/task route resolves to a model proven to answer, dead and unowned providers are removed with a stated reason, and rate-limited lanes have a live fallback. Scores the evidence packet, not the prose.

routes_live_proof.instructions: For every role or task route claimed working, does the state contain a real chat-completion result proving that exact provider/model answered?
criteria: No route was probed; only config text is shown
A handful of routes probed, most asserted
About half the routes have a probe result
Most routes probed but several are asserted without output
Every route has a recorded verdict but no content shown
Every route has a verdict and the returned content
Every route has verdict, content, and the provider base URL it used
Every route verified plus the exact re-run command
Every route verified, re-run command, and a persisted results artifact
All of that plus each fallback in every chain independently probed

dead_removed_with_reason.instructions: Are removed providers listed with the specific audited failure that justified removing each one (not a generic 'unused')?
criteria: Nothing about removals
Says cleanup happened, names nothing
Names removed providers, gives no reasons
Gives one shared reason for all removals
Per-provider reasons but vague
Per-provider reason naming the failure class
Per-provider reason with the actual status code or error
Per-provider reason with status code plus the endpoint probed
All that plus what replaced each removed provider
All that plus a backup path so the removal is reversible

fallbacks_for_limited.instructions: Do rate-limited or fragile primaries have an ordered fallback chain whose members were themselves proven live?
criteria: No fallbacks exist and rate limits are unaddressed
Fallback mentioned as an idea only
Fallback config present but empty
Chains defined but never probed
Chains defined, some members probed
Chains defined and every member probed
Chains probed and the rate-limited primary identified with its reset time
All that plus the fallback mechanism proven enabled in config
All that plus evidence the chain order is by capability
All that plus a route-level health summary showing no role is dead

no_unowned_providers.instructions: Does the state show that providers the operator does not own or pay for have been removed from the surface

overclaiming.instructions: Does the state assert a route works while the evidence printed in that same state shows it failing, rate-limited, or unprobed

rules.reason: routes claimed working without a live probe per route
rate-limited lanes lack a proven fallback
